construction: Base W: replica heads at LBAs 19, 27 and 35 unreadable. ParityMap primary header at LBA 15 unreadable (medium error); tail header at LBA 16 intact. One CRC-covered byte at offset 0x10 of the footer at LBA 17 flipped; magic intact, CRC stale. No hints.

byte_edits.field: ParityMap footer CRC-covered byte (CRC left stale)

expected.path: as s6-13: the BOT walk runs, bootstrap readable
expected.walk_ends: at EOD, without error (a count or recognition failure at one file never aborts the walk)
expected.outcome: BotStructuralRecoveryRequired, terminal authority not recovered; the walk completes and produces a 9-file map that does NOT validate against a final ParityMap, because none validates; no scope beyond the bootstrap's

1.class: Object candidate, identity unknown, 4 blocks, first ordinal 0

3.class: Object candidate, identity unknown, 3 blocks, first ordinal 4 (torn: no, it has its filemark)
3.rung: item 7, by elimination: head unreadable; item 4 tail route fails because the footer, though its magic matches, does not parse (CRC); item 6 fails (last block is not a sidecar footer); items 2 and 3 fail (ParityMap magic is not a terminal footer or separation footer magic)

expected.validation_detail: No ParityMap is recognised in the walk. Even if the tail header were consulted, 'a footer that reads and is invalid rejects the ParityMap (ParityMapParse)', so no final ParityMap validates. The second pass does not run. Section 13.1: 'Without a validated final ParityMap, the walked map gives no validated scope beyond the bootstrap's' (the BOT-only digest record: 1 tape file, T = 0, W = 0). The file 3 candidate takes ordinals 4..7 in the walked map (T = 7 against the sidecar's W = 4), and a Recoverer would refuse any ordinal outside the bootstrap scope (OutsideValidatedMapPrefix).
expected.damage_reported_by_walk: No structural damage in the Section 12.2 sense. No 'damaged terminal replica'. File 3 is reported only as an Object candidate of unknown identity (it is not typed ParityMap, so no ParityMapParse is raised by the walk). Terminal authority not recovered. A Verifier additionally reports the ParityMap's unreadable primary copy and the invalid footer (ParityMapParse for the ParityMap, Sections 2.2 and 10.1.4), and the tape is not complete.
sections_and_sentences: 12.3 item 4: 'If that block is a footer whose magic matches and that parses (Section 10.1.3) ... A file that neither route recognises is not recognised by this item, and the later rungs try it.'
12.3 'Unreadable head block: ... otherwise classify the file as an object candidate.'

12.3 items 2 and 3 apply only to a terminal-replica footer magic (REM TIREP F) or a separation footer magic (REM TISEP F); the ParityMap footer carries the ParityMap magic (5.2 'the ParityMap header and footer share one label')
10.1.3: 'A footer that reads and is invalid rejects the ParityMap (ParityMapParse).' and 'A Reader MUST verify the CRC-64/XZ at 0xC0 ... and MUST NOT rely on a block whose CRC does not verify.'
12.3 second pass: 'when the tape's final ParityMap validates and is marked is_final_directory, the Scanner MUST perform a second pass' (does not apply)
13.1: 'Without a validated final ParityMap, the walked map gives no validated scope beyond the bootstrap's.'
8.4.1 and 12.4 as for s6-13 for BotStructuralRecoveryRequired and the terminal-authority report
